# Diana

[Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society)

- **Age:** eighteen (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024)</sub>  
  _previously: 13 (v1)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) (relative), [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, rosy or crimson cheeks, and black hair described as glossy, jet-black tresses, and black curls. She is slightly plump and possesses endearing dimples.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Personality

Diana is a practical, good, and intelligent individual. Recognized for her notable taste in dressing, her fashion advice is frequently sought after by others. Additionally, she possesses a talent for culinary tasks, such as making splendid lettuce salad.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P9](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0009), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P2](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0002), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P25](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0025)_

## History

Named at birth by a schoolmaster boarding at her house, Diana grew up in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and learned fancy crochet stitches from her aunt in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). As a young girl, she became inseparable friends with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), naming local landmarks with her and imagining ghosts in the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood), until an incident where [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally served her currant wine made Diana sick and led her mother to forbid their friendship. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) saved Diana's baby sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) from croup, Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) lifted the ban, allowing the two to resume their close bond. Diana later joined [Anne](../character/anne.md) on a trip to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) to stay with her Great-[Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), where they enjoyed concerts, dining out, and the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) festivities. When [Anne](../character/anne.md) returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after completing her studies at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Diana was the one who rushed to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the news that [Anne](../character/anne.md) had tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island). Active in the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), Diana canvassed neighbors with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and shared many adventures, including a trip along the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road) where [Anne](../character/anne.md) fell through the roof of a duck house while looking for a willow-ware platter. On another occasion, the two lost their way in the woods and discovered [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they met the eccentric Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young maid. As they grew older, Diana was saddened by Anne's decision to resign her teaching post to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), though she reaffirmed their lifelong devotion to one another. Soon after, Diana became engaged to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), surprising [Anne](../character/anne.md) when she found them professing their love in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden. Diana then helped prepare for Miss Lavendar's garden wedding, celebrating the occasion alongside [Anne](../character/anne.md) and their friends before [Anne](../character/anne.md) departed for college.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P32](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER II. ## Quotes

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

> “The nicest I ever drank,” said Diana. “It’s ever so much nicer than Mrs. Lynde’s, although she brags of hers so much. It doesn’t taste a bit like hers.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P26](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0026)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--diana.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) is Diana's closest, most devoted friend, a bond formed in childhood and marked by intense romantic affection. Their friendship survived early trials, including a temporary ban imposed by Diana's mother when [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally served Diana homemade wine. Whether enduring tearful separations, getting into mischief together, or rushing to help in times of family medical crisis, Diana remains deeply loyal to her.

- Friend of — close and affectionate friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), +34 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Diana's absolute best friend and constant companion. Throughout their school days, they shared imaginative adventures, mutual support during academic examinations, and tearful reconciliations after childhood misunderstandings. Even as they face growing up and moving on toward higher education, Diana remains deeply committed to their lifelong bond.

- Friend of — best chums and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ### [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-josephine--diana.md)

[Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) (also referred to as [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md)) is Diana's wealthy great-aunt. Their relationship faced a rocky moment when Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally jumped on her in bed during a sleepover, leaving her furious and threatening to cancel Diana's music lessons. However, after [Anne](../character/anne.md) smoothed things over, [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) grew fond of the girls, sending Diana to deliver gifts like slippers to [Anne](../character/anne.md) and later inviting both girls to her estate in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), +1 more</sub>
